title: Evaluation agrees with ring evaluation
statement: Let $k$ be a positive natural number, let $a$ assign a natural number to each input index, and let $gs$ be a finite list of algebraic gates. Evaluating the gates modulo $k$ from the empty list and mapping the resulting values into $\mathbb Z/k\mathbb Z$ gives the same list as running those gates in $\mathbb Z/k\mathbb Z$ with each input assigned the residue of its value under $a$.
hypotheses_covered: a map from input indices to natural numbers
